gold: Wellens syndrome with critical left anterior descending coronary artery stenosis

selector.rationale: Decisive findings of chest pain with ECG changes, specifically deeply inverted T-waves and upright T-waves during pain, without ST segment elevation, support Variant Angina. The total occlusion at the ostium of the left anterior descending coronary artery also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Myocardial Infarction
rejected.why: Normal high-sensitivity troponin levels contradict this diagnosis

rejected.label: Hypertensive Heart Disease
rejected.why: While the patient has hypertension, the presentation is more consistent with a primary cardiac issue rather than hypertensive heart disease

rejected.label: Coronary Artery Disease
rejected.why: While coronary artery disease is present, Variant Angina is a more specific diagnosis that explains the patient's symptoms and ECG findings
